52 Singaporeans Detained in China Over Alleged Pyramid Scheme

Chinese authorities have arrested and detained 52 Singaporeans in the Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region as part of a crackdown on suspected pyramid scheme activities. Singaporean authorities confirmed the detentions, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has been providing consular assistance. Sources indicate the individuals have been detained since at least mid-July. Some reports suggest Singaporeans were lured by fellow citizens into a business and investment scheme in Nanning, China, which was presented as an attractive investment opportunity.
